purpose_context: The muster <-> Spec Kitty agent-conformance programme (wave 2, MOES-Media/spec-kitty issue #25) is authoring trigger-routing query sets for the skills whose names and descriptions most plausibly collide: five legacy-vs-spk duplicate pairs and the spk-run-next/spk-run-review-wp/spk-run-implement-review cluster. Query-set authoring can start now; live execution is blocked until muster's behavioral skill-trigger adapter (M5, now released as muster 1.2.1) is available. This mission produces the query sets, a behavioral manifest pinned to a specific model and threshold, a discrimination control, and a cadence workflow that reports drift over time -- without touching any SKILL.md itself.
purpose_tldr: Prove whether the five legacy/spk duplicate skill pairs and the run-family cluster actually route to the right SKILL.md, with a live-model conformance suite that ships its own rigged-impossible control.
